title: LNERGO Fingerprint Formula for James Earl Ray
title_ja: ジェームズ・アール・レイのフィンガープリント・フォーミュラ
summary: This cable relays information about the positive identification of James Earl Ray as the accused assassin based on LNERGO fingerprint formula. It also requests the information be passed to a liaison.
